sourceTitle: Extra Creamy Brie With Dried Fruit and Almonds
sourceText:
Extra Creamy Brie With Dried Fruit and Almonds
By: Corrinne
Published: Wednesday, April 28, 2010 - 11:22am

Ingredients




1 package Dried Apricots (Figs as alternate)
Sliced Almonds

Toasted Crackers (Alternate freshly toasted baguette)

1 package (5oz) Alouette Extra Creamy Brie

Preparation

1 Leave Brie out for about an hour prior to prepping. 2 Slice the Brie in ¼ inches slices. 3 Places slices on top of crackers or baguette. 4 Layer dried fruit and almonds on cheese to taste

About


New all-natural Extra Creamy Brie is a unique triple crème brie perfect for everyday snacking and just perfect with dried fruit and almonds.
